sentences.en: We use gestures as well as words to communicate with others.
sentences.zh: 我们不仅用言语还用手势与他人交流。

sentences.en: He made a gesture to me to run away.
sentences.zh: 他朝我做了个手势让我逃跑。

sentences.en: The acceptability of a social gesture depends on innumerable cultural factors.
sentences.zh: 社交中的一个手势是否合适取决于无数的文化因素。

senses.zh: 手势, 姿势 - 姿态, 表示 -
